plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, speaks of an object said to lie inside the mesa, a flat-topped hill, at Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for strange reports and the subject of the TV series Secrets of Skinwalker Ranch. He says such objects have been located but are hard to dig out, because it is as if they have a life of their own. If true, it would mean something alive or self-willed is buried there.
